independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests, harnesses and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/**, docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). The round-12 repairs (D-072: BE17 eb455d3 by backend-workflow-engineer, FE9 644198a by frontend-ux-engineer) are not mine. Every result here comes from qa-verifier's own runs in three disposable clones under $TMPDIR, all removed at the end. Two clones are at 744af0b, the round-12 freeze on top of source 8488e7a. The third is a throwaway clone used for the guard negative controls at 744af0b and for the pre-BE17 baseline at 309aff2. At the start HEAD was 744af0b; 8488e7a..744af0b changes only assignments, the manifest and stages.json. The recomputed candidate ID matched (552 files) in the tree and in both clones. During the run HEAD moved to 26d0c60 through the other reviewers' auto-committed round-12 evidence and a round-13 assignment. I did not open those files; I saw only their commit subjects in `git log`. At the end the candidate ID was still 5dfecce4... with 552 files (00-candidate-end.log). My verdict and F-DG2-460 come from my own runs and were formed without reading any other reviewer's round-12 record.

checks_run.procedure: Investigation of the R11-02(b) failure. On a separate API process, stall an upload in flight (2 MiB of 10 MiB), send SIGTERM, then list every file the store holds for the item (name and size). Start a new API process on the same store and list again. Check the content row, currentContentId and the download. Control: the same stall, but the client aborts while the process keeps running. Baseline: the identical probe on the round-11 freeze 309aff2 (pre-BE17).
checks_run.command: e2e/support/qa-stack.sh npx playwright test e2e/dg2-qa-r12.spec.ts -g R12-07 --workers=1 (744af0b, both locale settings; and 309aff2, C.UTF-8)
checks_run.environment: clone $TMPDIR/review-dg2-e2e @744af0b and throwaway clone $TMPDIR/review-dg2-guard @309aff2 (built); pre-installed Chromium; chromium-en and chromium-ar
checks_run.expected: no file left in the store after any failed upload, including one cut by a graceful shutdown
checks_run.actual: At 744af0b: exit 1 in both locale settings, 2 failed (en and ar). Assertion 'files left in the evidence store after the process exited' expected [] but received ['/<uuid>/<uuid>/<item>/<uuid>.part (2097152 B)']. SIGTERM -> exit 0 in about 5.02 s. The .part is still there after a restart on the same store. Content rows 0, currentContentId null, GET content 404. The control part of the same test (client abort while the process stays up) leaves [] in every run. At 309aff2 the identical probe exits 0 (2 passed): after SIGTERM the store is []. So this is a regression introduced by BE17: the body is now received without a pooled connection, so main.ts's db.destroy() no longer waits for the upload handler's async cleanup before process.exit(0). Raised as F-DG2-460 (Medium, non-mandatory).

summary: FAIL on candidate 5dfecce4 (552 files, source 8488e7a). F-DG2-430 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. The 'Cannot update a component' warning is gone from all 7 unit runs (Node 22 and 24, both locale settings, plus a run under load); the guard fails the suite when the impure updater is reintroduced; and the Team preview follows the role in EN (LTR) and AR (RTL). The BE17 regression focus passes: an edit during the body gets 409 with nothing stored; 25 stalled uploads (more than the pool's 20) block neither other users nor /readyz, and no session idles in a transaction (positive control detected); aborted JSON and upload bodies cause no 500 and no error-level log; binaries are stored byte-exact; Unicode round-trips verbatim; R8-05/R9-05 messages are shown once. Static checks, unit (7 of 7 runs, 790 tests each), integration (6 of 6 runs, 640 tests each), product e2e (64 of 64 per setting) and axe (636 scans, 0 serious or critical) are green. One regression: an upload in flight at SIGTERM now leaves an orphaned .part file holding the partial user bytes in the evidence store. It survives a restart and nothing removes it. The round-11 freeze left nothing in the same probe. This failed R11-02 in 4 of 4 QA-stack executions and the dedicated probe R12-07 in both settings. Raised as F-DG2-460 (Medium, non-mandatory, owner backend-workflow-engineer). Because something has regressed, the verdict is FAIL. Residuals D-057, D-058 and D-049 are PASS on the offline/config surface. No business approval is implied.
